about: Ends the sessions an attacker may be holding, after the credentials have been reset or the account suspended.
credential: An API token made by an administrator whose only role is one that can suspend users and clear their sessions — a custom role with those two permissions, or Help Desk Administrator scoped to the groups concerned. Not the token a connector reads with: that one is made by a read-only administrator so that it cannot do this.

action.name: okta-clear-sessions
action.title: Clear an Okta account's sessions

target.what: an Okta user id, as the system log names the actor

action.effect: Every Okta session the account has open is ended, so the next request from any browser has to sign in again.
action.reverts: It cannot be undone and does not need to be: the person signs in again. Somebody who holds the password and a factor can too, so this is not containment by itself.
